## ConditionalResourceRelease_004e0d70 — ConditionalResourceRelease

**Summary:** Conditionally releases a UI resource — transplants node from doubly-linked list, clears init flag, and calls flag field update. Reverse counterpart of LazyInitCallback.

**Frame-path:** ON_FRAME_PATH  
**Call frequency:** per-frame tick

**Called by:** SubslotCleanup (004e0e70), SubsystemStateMachine (004e17c0), RepairServiceStateDispatcher (004ed250)

**Struct fields accessed:**

| Base | Offset | R/W | Init (literal → value) | Purpose |
|------|--------|-----|------------------------|---------|
| this | 0x0 | R | — | Pointer to the UI element/resource node |
| this | 0x40 | RW | 0 | Init flag — 1 = initialized, cleared to 0 on release |

**Written-by note (persistence):**
- this 0x40: recalc every frame — external poke does NOT persist

**Globals referenced:**

| Address | Name | R/W | Role |
|---------|------|-----|------|

**Functions called:**

| Address | Name | Purpose |
|---------|------|---------|
| 0054baa0 | DoublyLinkedListNodeTransplant | Removes/transplants element node from active list |
| 0054c030 | FlagFieldBitManipulation | Updates flag field (visibility/activation bits) |

**Guard conditions:** Checks *a1 (element pointer). If NULL, returns immediately. Checks *(byte*)(a1+64) (init flag). If zero, skips release body. PASSES: both conditions true -> release. BLOCKED: NULL element or not initialized.

policy: Raw source and deterministic facts outrank all semantic proposals.
